name: Bonn
registryBasis: The City of Bonn states that its Liegenschaftskataster covers the entire municipal area and that parcel/building records are maintained in ALKIS. The official NRW INSPIRE-WFS catalog identifies the state download service for ALKIS cadastral parcels; official NRW metadata describes AX_Flurstueck as multipolygon data. Service identity and CRS are documented, but no actual point-bounded geometry response was fetched in this environment, so no sample or runtime-ready claim is made.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: 79 valid distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Bonn WUP settlement locator. The existing shared North Rhine-Westphalia OGC API provider is reused. Complete offset paging, forced three-row pages, all 79 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 25 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32632 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.
